claude-haiku-4-5.description: Fastest and most cost-efficient Claude model. Best for classification, extraction, structured JSON, and simple summarization.

claude-sonnet-4-6.description: Best balance of intelligence and speed. Handles complex reasoning, multi-step analysis, and high-quality text generation.

claude-opus-4-7.description: Most capable Claude model. Use for the highest-complexity tasks requiring deep reasoning, long-horizon planning, or nuanced judgment.
